name: Editorial Depth
tagline: Magazine typography behind and in front of the speaker
description: Dark navy letterbox with the 16:9 shot in the middle. The speaker is cut out automatically so words live behind their head: tall didone capitals across the top of the frame building word by word with one red key word, a huge red script word behind the head with a small caps line in front, or condensed caps + italic serif next to the head. Text follows the head, layouts rotate and every third phrase is left empty so the face can breathe. Mixed fonts, premium, magazine-like.
best_for: quotes with one strong key word
